newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's cuts Ashikaga Bank's deposit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts Ashikaga Bank's deposit ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday that it had cut its ratings on Ashikaga Bank Ltd's long-term and short-term deposits to "Baa3/P-3" from "Baa1/P-2."
Concurrently, the bank's financial strength rating was lowered to "E+" from "D."
The rating agency also said that it had cut the bank's rating for convertable eurodebentures to "Baa3" from "Baa1."
Moody's also downgraded the bank's counterparty rating to Baa3 from Baa1.
The rating cuts were due to the bank's limited financial resources and the scale of its asset quality problems, Moody's said.
